$description: Code-side radius roles, not in Figma. Figma gives buttons and form fields the same form-element radius; these roles let a theme change one without the other (for example pill buttons and square fields). By default they point to the Figma radius, so the look is unchanged. Each role has a small step for the small (and tiny) sizes. The ladom-ui CLI sets them in theme.css with --button-radius and --form-radius.

button.usedFor: Button, large and medium (Icon Button stays round)

form.usedFor: Form fields, medium and large: Input and the fields built on it (Textarea, NumberInput, CurrencyInput, GsmInput, ColorInput), OtpInput, the Segment track

form-small.usedFor: Form fields, small, plus Selectbox, ItemSelector, Uploader and the Segment items
